name: ivo
description: Ivo's personal skill set: coding standards, slop cleanup, teaching mode, plain-English answers, context auditing, codebase roasts, and background removal.

interface.shortDescription: Ivo's personal working style, in one plugin
interface.longDescription: Seven portable skills Ivo uses across Claude Code and Codex: code for smallest-complete-solution implementation and review, deslop for evidence-based cleanup, teach for Socratic guidance, simple for plain-English answers, context-check for auditing loaded instructions, roast-codebase for humorous-but-useful review, and remove-bg-image for transparent-PNG cutouts.
defaultPrompt: Use $ivo:deslop to audit my current changes.
Use $ivo:teach and walk me through this.
